blocks.text: There’s something almost intimate about opening someone’s Letterboxd profile. “What are your four favorite films?” It sounds like such a simple question, until you’re essentially asking someone to introduce themselves through cinema. Suddenly, you’re asking a much bigger question: Who are you when nobody is watching? Whatever the choice, those four little posters can say more than a biography ever could. Five stars, four films, countless personalities On Letterboxd, every film you log becomes another entry in a growing archive of your taste.
